name: feel-the-notion
description: Notion-like block editing for Live Preview. Forked from BCS1037/notion-block v1.4.0.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: MichaelNguyen5653
comment:codemirror: Pinned to the EXACT versions obsidian's peerDependencies declare. These packages are `external` in esbuild — Obsidian supplies them at runtime — so the pins only feed TypeScript. Using a different version typechecks against an API that isn't what ships. Re-check with `npm view obsidian@latest peerDependencies` when bumping obsidian.
comment:overrides: npm otherwise installs a SECOND @codemirror/state under @codemirror/commands. CodeMirror identifies facets and state fields by object identity, so two copies means history() registers against facets our EditorState has never heard of — undo silently becomes a no-op. Harmless in Obsidian, where every @codemirror package is `external` and Obsidian supplies exactly one copy, but it makes the test harness test nothing. Forced to Obsidian's own pinned version so tests exercise the same code that ships.
